customManagers.description: The SBOM steps run the CycloneDX npm generator with npx, which no Renovate manager reads. Its version is the CYCLONEDX_NPM_VERSION value of the workflow.
The SBOM validation installs jsonschema with pip in the workflows, where no Renovate manager reads it.

packageRules.description: Major updates are never automerged and are labelled for manual review. Renovate has no license detection, so the license check has to be done by a human on the PR.
prBodyNotes: - [ ] Read the upstream changelog and release notes for breaking changes.
- [ ] Confirm the dependency license did not change. A package can switch from a free to a commercial license under the same package id, and Renovate does not detect that.

packageRules.description: Let new npm releases settle before proposing them. Packaging and license mistakes are usually reported within a few days.
Group all GitHub Actions and reusable workflow pin updates into a single pull request.
docker-compose.yml pins this project's own published image. Its version is owned by the release process, not by Renovate.
